scope: Model revision provenance from actual owned Linux process capture; no claim of GPU execution or engine package identity.
oracle: Foreign/stale/malformed process snapshots, incorrect argv, mixed Docker/process proofs and unsuccessful or mismatched boot must not produce a model revision. Exact pinned actual argv plus owner tuple and matching completed boot can.
red: process-evidence-red.log:16 test methods,32 failing subcases because assembler rejected new input flags.
timing: Capture after completed boot and before teardown; snapshot captured_at must be >= created_at and >= boot.start_epoch+total_s with1second rounding allowance.
stopping_rule: Known-bad CLI cases red; all existing and process-positive/negative tests green,typos anddiffchecks clean; commit ownedfiles and hand off to runner integration.
limits: Synthetic fixtures prove assembler decisions; process manager owns actual Linux proc reads.
Python executable SHA does not prove vLLM installed package identity.
No model revision inferred from recipe pins.
No artifact schema or shared ladder changes.
